newsitem.title: GERMANY: REFILE-Metro unit Praktiker operating profit down.
newsitem.headline: REFILE-Metro unit Praktiker operating profit down.

text.p: Retail group Metro AG's Praktiker Bau- und Heimwerkermaerkte AG posted pre-tax profits for the 1995-96 business year of 200 million marks ($133 million), down from 220 million marks a year before, Metro said on Monday.
The company, which had turnover of 4.2 billion marks, will pay an unchanged dividend of 1.90 marks per share, according to a statement issued after a supervisory board meeting.

Praktiker chief executive Gerd Krampe will leave the company at the end of the year and will be replaced by Michael Arnold. Board member Karl-Peter Uhle will also leave, while Hermann-Josef Brausch and Alfred Grasmueck will join the board.
